title: Paloma and the Parish
author: Petra Whitlock
blurb: Beatrix Ashgrove, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the statute expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
